title: To all you mall rats who know what i mean.
content: The mall is the dream. if you look up, and see black in the sky above you, you are dreaming, and should be burning the mall down. there used to be stars in our dreams. I have removed them as a gift. I have always been blind to the stars and the angels and the devils and the shadowy govt agents in our dreams. the angels are hidden. the devils are hidden. it was us all along. Burn the matrix machine down. Find the torment nexus and turn it off. Or, just remember how you used to fly instead. How we met up at the mall because once there, we could go off grid, and practice magic. Mommy and daddy are together again. The roll call of the century is going out. Do you wanna be a kid again? be a kid again. Do you miss being a god! be a god again. the lolipops used to be infinite.
